public_rationale: Zitron forecasts a $5 billion minimum in 2027, gives $10 billion as a qualified estimate, and describes a possible later $30 billion annual scale [wyea-exit-liquidity-729aa8-o1]. The October 26, 2026 announcement describes financing through a vehicle that would lease equipment to Anthropic, with deliveries expected from 2027 [e6]. It provides no actual 2027 lease payments and establishes no event that settles the $5 billion minimum early [e6].
limitations: Calendar 2027 had not begun at the October 28, 2026 evaluation date.
Financing amounts and expected deliveries do not establish actual lease payments or direct payments to Broadcom.
Payments through a financing vehicle must discharge the relevant Anthropic lease obligation. Interest must be identified separately.
The $10 billion estimate is not a second minimum. The possible later $30 billion annual scale has no deadline.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic will pay Broadcom at least $5B (possibly $10B) in 2027, rising to as much as $30B a year.

statement.excerpt: Nevertheless, that’s at least $5 billion next year, if not more like $10 billion, growing to as much as $30 billion a year.

from_speaker: growing to as much as $30 billion a year
our_interpretation: The firm threshold is at least USD 5 billion of Anthropic payments under the Broadcom-related equipment leases during 2027.
USD 10 billion is a qualified estimate, not a second minimum.
As much as USD 30 billion describes possible later annual scale without a deadline. It is not a requirement to pay USD 30 billion in 2027.
Unclear capacity timing is an acknowledged uncertainty, not an explicit antecedent that excuses the firm 2027 minimum.

The annual amounts are the speaker's estimates from reported lease commitments, rather than quoted annual payment guidance. Payments through an assigned lease or financing vehicle count only if they discharge the same Anthropic lease obligation.
criteria.support_condition: Records show Anthropic paid at least USD 5 billion under the relevant Broadcom-related lease arrangements during calendar 2027. Assess any later rise toward USD 30 billion separately when comparable annual payment records exist.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Complete calendar-2027 records show relevant payments below USD 5 billion. A later annual amount below USD 30 billion alone does not contradict the undated, qualified possibility.
